The implementation manually parses `process.argv`, uses no external dependencies, keeps all imports local, and reproduces the Python `bech32.convertbits` flow closely, including the later runtime failure pattern when `step1` becomes `None`/`null`.

Verification: I diffed the Node output against `/workspace/dataset/test14_executable` for all 4 provided sample cases, and they matched exactly. I also checked `-h`, missing required args, repeated args, `--arg=value`, unknown args, and invalid integer parsing; the argparse-style behavior matches, with the expected program-name difference (`test14.mjs` instead of `test14_executable`).
